import re

ROW = re.compile(r'^(?P<pre>.*?)\s*(?P<dst>[0-9A-Fa-f.:]+/\d+)(?:\s+(?P<gw>\S+))?\s+(?P<dist>\d+)\s*$')
PRE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<num>\d+)?\s*(?P<flags>.*?)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    rows = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    comment = None
    cidx = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if s.startswith(';;;'):
            comment = s[3:].strip()
            cidx = i
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\[.*\]\s*>', s) or s.startswith('Flags:') or s.startswith('Columns:') or re.match(r'^#\s+DST-ADDRESS', s):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(l)
        if not m:
            continue
        p = PRE.match(m.group('pre'))
        rows.append({'#': p.group('num') or '', 'Flags': p.group('flags'), 'DST-ADDRESS': m.group('dst'), 'GATEWAY': m.group('gw') or '', 'DISTANCE': int(m.group('dist')), 'Comment': comment or ''})
        if cidx is not None:
            used.append(cidx)
        used.append(i)
        comment = None
        cidx = None
    return {'blocks': [{'name': 'routes', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': rows}], 'skip': skip}
